name: Dunnage Settings Shell
summary: Category-based Dunnage settings workflow rebuilt around live setting behavior only: personal defaults, shared image assets, image presentation, workflow visuals, and keyboard shortcuts. The retired overview, permissions, and audit placeholder pages remain on disk only and are no longer part of runtime navigation.

userActions: Open a Dunnage settings category from the hub
Change the default Dunnage location used when guided entry leaves location blank
Tune personal thumbnail size and part-image preference
Choose the shared folder used for Dunnage images
Set the maximum image import file size
Control whether type and part images appear in Dunnage screens
Control when images appear during the Dunnage workflow
Configure Dunnage workflow keyboard shortcuts and the Ctrl+T simple navigation toggle
Save or reset each category independently
preserveRules: Keep all live Dunnage setting keys unchanged
Do not route users to the retired overview, permissions, or audit pages
Keep the default-location fuzzy validation behavior against warehouse 002
Keep personal and shared Dunnage settings scoped the same way they are in code
acceptanceCriteria: The hub routes only to the five live Dunnage setting categories
Metadata reflects that Dunnage settings are now organized by behavior instead of the old page names
Metadata does not imply the retired placeholder pages are still part of runtime navigation
validationHints: Confirm the Dunnage hub opens the five live category pages
Confirm personal defaults still validate Dunnage location values with fuzzy suggestions
Confirm the image-assets page updates the shared image folder and file size limit
Confirm the image-presentation and workflow-visual pages preserve the existing Dunnage setting keys
Confirm the keyboard-shortcuts page persists Dunnage shortcut changes per user and updates the Ctrl+T toggle setting
Confirm search destinations no longer include retired Dunnage overview, permissions, or audit pages
